svg.title: What 100 Probate Leads Become
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-probate-lead-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: What 100 Probate Leads Become; subtitle: Per-100-lead figures reported by probate listing specialists; caption: Probate inventory does not care about rates, but it rewards volume and follow-up; three touches do not do it.; assumptions note: Stages combine per-100-lead figures from different speakers and are not a single tracked cohort. Carolynn Castillo reports 20 to 40 leads a week per county.; note: Figures from Probate Mastery (Bruce Hill) and Carolynn Castillo; the must-sell share is the Probate Mastery 10 to 15 percent estimate.; stages: label: Raw probate leads; value: 100; display: 100 leads; conversion: Baseline; detail: Most counties produce 20 to 40 leads a week, about 1 to 2 hours of calling.; label: Leads with real estate; value: 70; display: About 70; conversion: About 70% carry real estate; detail: Bruce Hill counts about 70 of 100 raw leads holding real estate.; label: Live conversations, call-first; value: 50; display: About 50; conversion: About 50 per 100 leads; detail: Roughly $400 of ISA cost versus $900 for 600 mailers.; label: Estates that have to sell; value: 10; display: About 10; conversion: 10 to 15% of leads; detail: Probate Mastery estimates 10 to 15 of every 100 leads have to go.; label: Closed deals; value: 1.5; display: About 1.5; conversion: About 1.5 per 100 raw leads; detail: 20 to 25% of pipeline reaches an appointment and about 15 to 20% close.

rect.title: label: Raw probate leads; value: 100; display: 100 leads; conversion: Baseline; detail: Most counties produce 20 to 40 leads a week, about 1 to 2 hours of calling.
label: Leads with real estate; value: 70; display: About 70; conversion: About 70% carry real estate; detail: Bruce Hill counts about 70 of 100 raw leads holding real estate.
label: Live conversations, call-first; value: 50; display: About 50; conversion: About 50 per 100 leads; detail: Roughly $400 of ISA cost versus $900 for 600 mailers.
label: Estates that have to sell; value: 10; display: About 10; conversion: 10 to 15% of leads; detail: Probate Mastery estimates 10 to 15 of every 100 leads have to go.
label: Closed deals; value: 1.5; display: About 1.5; conversion: About 1.5 per 100 raw leads; detail: 20 to 25% of pipeline reaches an appointment and about 15 to 20% close.

text.title: Assumptions: Stages combine per-100-lead figures from different speakers and are not a single tracked cohort. Carolynn Castillo reports 20 to 40 leads a week per county.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Stages combine per-100-lead figures from different speakers and are not a single tracked cohort. Carolynn Castillo
reports 20 to 40 leads a week per county.
